summary: Added a specified two-state common stochastic variance scenario and compared its 99% VaR/ES with calibrated GBM using identical normal draws and fixed Black-Scholes repricing. The studio and lab export full paired evidence from synthetic prices: twelve seeds give mean VaR/ES increases of 26.5503/81.2760 USD with numerical SEs 1.5666/2.0373 USD. Includes explicit variance normalization, model limitations, costs and dated user-CSV support. Existing public defaults and four prior cases are preserved; twenty tests pass and five studio cases reproduce. This measures model sensitivity without claiming market accuracy or quantum advantage.
